summary: Russian forces claimed to have liberated 91 populated points during the summer 2026 campaign, marking a major territorial advance. A strike on a Nova Poshta terminal in Odessa was confirmed, damaging a distribution center used for military supplies, indicating a deliberate attack on logistical infrastructure in the southern region by an air strike. Russian air defenses shot down over 90 'Flamingo' cruise missiles during the summer, per daily defense ministry reports.
key_points: Russian forces claimed to have liberated 91 populated points during the summer 2026 campaign, marking a major territorial advance. (Source: @tass_agency/392933)

Odessa regional authorities confirmed a strike on a Nova Poshta terminal, destroying a distribution center that Ukrainian forces use to store and distribute military supplies, indicating a deliberate attack on logistical infrastructure in the southern region by an air strike. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32877)

Attack drone operators from the Southern Group destroyed Ukrainian logistics in Druzhkovka and Malotaranovka, disrupting supply routes and equipment caches in the eastern front and disrupting Ukrainian resupply efforts, as reported by Ukrainian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32875)
Russian air defenses shot down over 90 'Flamingo' cruise missiles during the summer, per daily defense ministry reports. (Source: @tass_agency/392938)
One person was killed and three injured in Ukrainian strikes on Belgorod region, according to operational staff reports. (Source: @tass_agency/392916)

Ammunition stored in residential areas in Ukraine damaged about 300 structures, including over 200 private homes and 14 high-rise buildings, causing civilian casualties. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32899)
Kiev authorities may grant frontline status to the capital and surrounding region as early as September, according to a parliamentary draft resolution. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32897)
